newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CIG-WH says in HK$55 mln equity issue.
newsitem.headline: CIG-WH says in HK$55 mln equity issue.

text.p: Construction concern CIG-WH International (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it would place 24 million new shares, or 9.09 percent of its enlarged share capital, to private and professional investors at HK$2.35 each.
The net proceeds of about HK$55 million would be used for working capital for certain construction and development projects under negotiations in China, the company said.
The deal is expected to be completed on March 26, it said.
The company's shares closed at HK$2.45 on Friday.
